label: Stockbee and daily
notes: A scan is a list of charts that match a rule, not a list of stocks to buy.
Fundamentals read for 1861 symbols: 358 had no revenue data, 1476 had 5+ quarters, 0 had 6+. Scans 2-4 need 6 quarters, so they can only match when that last number is above zero.
Market cap: Yahoo's figure for 1736 of 1867 symbols, price x 30-day volume for the rest.

scans.label: Bearish Momentum
scans.rule: Close below yesterday's low and the 50-day average, RSI under 50

scans.label: VCP Setup
scans.rule: Strong 1- or 3-month run above the 200-day average with size

scans.label: Satish Bullish
scans.rule: Green bar above pivot with rising lows, volume above its 10-day average

scans.label: Hardik Scan
scans.rule: Weekly RSI above 50, green bar after a red one, above the 10-day average

scans.label: NR6 Narrowest Range
scans.rule: Today's range is the narrowest of the last 7 bars

scans.label: Rocket Base
scans.rule: Up 20% in 5 days, or 30% in 30 or 90 days, from the low

scans.label: EP Breakout
scans.rule: 5-day closing high at least 5% above the prior 120-day closing high, on rising volume

scans.label: 20-Day High
scans.rule: Close at or above the 20-day high

scans.label: 2-Month High
scans.rule: Close at or above the 42-day high

scans.label: Gap Up 3%
scans.rule: Open at least 3% above the prior close

scans.label: Up 4%+
scans.rule: Close at least 4% above the open

scans.label: Stockbee Momentum
scans.rule: Close at least 2 ATR above the 70-day average, with price above it

scans.label: Stockbee 2: Sales Growth
scans.rule: Revenue up 39%+ in the last quarter and the 2-quarter average

scans.label: Stockbee 3: Growth / Turnaround
scans.rule: Scan 2 plus market cap under $11B and IPO within 10 years

scans.label: Stockbee 4: Earnings + Sales
scans.rule: EPS up 39%+ in both quarters, revenue up 20%+
